title: Export all your data
summary: How to get everything in your books out as spreadsheet files, so you are never locked in.

steps.text: Click Settings in the sidebar, and find the About card.
Click Export all data…, and choose where to put it. A new folder is made there, named with today's date and time.
The card says how many files were written. Open the folder in Finder, and open any file in Numbers, Excel or Google Sheets.

image.description: The About card: the version, the books status, a sentence that the books are one file on this Mac, the message Exported 7 files to the folder, and the buttons Show in Finder and Export all data.

sections.heading: What is in it
paragraphs: accounts.csv is your chart of accounts. entries.csv is every transaction, one row per line, with debit, credit and GST. bank-accounts.csv, contacts.csv, invoices.csv and rules.csv hold the rest. README.txt explains each file.
Adding up debit less credit for each account in entries.csv gives the same balances as the trial balance.
The export is not a backup: it cannot be restored into the app. Use Back up for that.

sections.heading: If something goes wrong
paragraphs: Nothing happens after choosing a folder: check you can save files there, such as on a drive that is not locked.
